title.narrative: Labor-intensive Maintenance in Public Areas, Phase II: Public Schools

description.narrative: This project aims at improving livelihoods, supporting the labour market and economy, and contributing to the social cohesion among communities impacted by the Syrian crisis in Jordan, through provision of cash for work opportunities for both Jordanians and Syrian refugees, especially women and youth, in Amman, Irbid, Mafraq, Balqa, Ajloun, and Zaqra Governorates. It also aims at improving the resource constrained public education services and facilities that are most affected by the Syria crisis.
